description: This Java class provides static methods to create collectors for JSON processing, such as converting JSON fields and objects into JSON objects, arrays, and key lists. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.json package and implements various reduction operations for JSON data.

classes.name: JsonCollectors
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create JSON-related collectors for reducing JSON data into objects and arrays.

methods.name: fieldsToObject
methods.description: Creates a collector that accumulates JSON fields into a JsonObject.

methods.name: objectsToObject
methods.description: Creates a collector that accumulates JSON objects into a JsonObject.

methods.name: fieldKeysToArray
methods.description: Creates a collector that accumulates the keys of JSON fields into a JsonArray.

methods.name: fieldValuesToArray
methods.description: Creates a collector that accumulates the values of JSON fields into a JsonArray.

methods.name: valuesToArray
methods.description: Creates a collector that accumulates JSON values into a JsonArray.
